scope: Exploratory known public DEV1/DEV3 high-overlap sources, one observation per condition; no holdout/generalization claim.
gates: At most 120 words, existing citation syntax and all necessary source units cited
Every factual assertion supported by supplied public excerpts; no fabricated facts
All requested aspects addressed; no factual loss in exact-v1 relative to preserve; both independently correct against sources

required_aspects: Distinguish the evidence supplied by each named source
Address whether the snapshot establishes contradiction, staleness, error or publication, respecting limits of the excerpts
Trace tokenBudget from schema through service to optimize
State limits/default, estimator effective unit, and which envelope is counted using the supplied units

decision: Approve quality only if both independent source assessments pass all gates and paired factual-loss check passes; otherwise fail or inconclusive. Missing/failed/not_run response is inconclusive, never a pass. Tokens, cache and time cannot override quality failure.
